description: This file defines a React component 'TestFileView' used to display details of test files, including test cases, their outcomes, and attachments such as images and videos. It also contains helper components for badges indicating image diffs and videos.

methods.name: ImageDiffBadge
methods.description: A React component that checks test results for image attachments (expected, actual, diff) and renders a link badge if such attachments are found.

methods.name: VideoBadge
methods.description: A React component that searches for a video attachment within test results and renders a link badge to view it.
